sv.title: Besegrade ukrainska – hyllades av Putin
sv.summary: Ryska tennisstjärnan Mirra Andrejeva, 19, vann i helgen WTA-slutspelet i Indian Wells efter finalseger mot ukrainskan Elina Svitolina. Då passade Vladimir Putin på att skicka en hälsning.

en.title: Defeated Ukrainian – praised by Putin
en.summary: Russian tennis star Mirra Andreeva, 19, won the WTA Finals in Indian Wells at the weekend after beating Ukraine's Elina Svitolina in the final. Vladimir Putin then took the opportunity to send a greeting.
